verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents delegating work to built-in Agents. The composer can create a Task (lobe-chat-docs-56), tasks can be scheduled for Agents to handle (lobe-chat-docs-24, lobe-chat-docs-31), and the Home dashboard shows what Agents are still running or did while you were away (lobe-chat-docs-45). It also describes an orchestrating agent that dispatches other agents and assembles teams automatically for a task (lobe-chat-docs-54, lobe-chat-docs-74, lobe-chat-docs-17). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that task delegation works as described, and in-depth task docs beyond changelog and marketing copy.
